acceptance: Add a --rare N option to wordstats count that keeps only words with N or fewer occurrences, with the filtering logic in a new module src/wordstats/rarewords.py.
Add a --top N option to wordstats count that keeps only the N most frequent words with ties broken alphabetically, with the logic in a new module src/wordstats/topwords.py.
Both options validate N as a positive integer and exit 2 with a clear message otherwise.
Each helper module is implemented by a separate delegated child worker with its own bounded child task record, and the two children run concurrently.
Both modules are integrated into the CLI, with unit tests covering both options and their rejection behavior.
Design-note and records conventions are followed, and bash checks/validate.sh passes.
